Stephan vs State Of Kerala on 11 September, 2024 
Author: Dinesh Kumar Singh Bench: Dinesh Kumar Singh WP(C) NO. 31525 OF 2024  1  2024:KER:69561  IN THE HIGH COURT OF KERALA AT ERNAKULAM  PRESENT  THE HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE DINESH KUMAR SINGH  WEDNESDAY, THE 11TH DAY OF SEPTEMBER 2024 / 20TH BHADRA, 1946  WP(C) NO. 31525 OF 2024 PETITIONER:
 STEPHAN,
 AGED 64 YEARS  S/O.THARIYATH, EDATTUKARAN HOUSE, KALLETTUMKARA DESOM,
 KALLETTUMKARA P.O, CHALAKUDY TALUK, THRISSUR DISTRICT, 
 PIN - 680683  BY ADVS.
 N.L.BITTO  MITHUL T ANTO RESPONDENTS: 
 1 STATE OF KERALA  REP. BY THE SECRETARY TO THE GOVT., PUBLIC WORKS  DEPARTMENT, GOVT. SECRETARIAT, THIRUVANANTHAPURAM, PIN  - 695001  2 DISTRICT COLLECTOR,
 THRISSUR DISTRICT, COLLECTORATE, AYYANTHOLE P.O.,
 THRISSUR DISTRICT, PIN - 680003  3 ASSISTANT ENGINEER,
 PWD DEPARTMENT, ROAD SECTION, IRINJALAKKUDA, THRISSUR Stephan vs State Of Kerala on 11 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/71019136/
1  DISTRICT, PIN - 680121  4 ALOOR GRAMA PANCHAYATH,
 REPRESENTED BY ITS SECRETARY, KALLETTUMKARA P.O,
 MUKUNDAPURAM TALUK, THRISSUR DISTRICT, PIN - 680684  5 HEALTH INSPECTOR,
 PRIMARY HEALTH CENTRE, ALOOR, THRISSUR DISTRICT, PIN -  680683  WP(C) NO. 31525 OF 2024  2  2024:KER:69561  BY ADV PHILIP T.VARGHESE  SRI.S. GOPINATHAN -SR.GP  THIS WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 11.09.2024, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 WP(C) NO. 31525 OF 2024  3  2024:KER:69561  JUDGMENT Dated this the 11th day of September, 2024 The present Writ Petition has been filed impugning Ext.P2 notice for demolition of the shed allegedly constructed by encroaching the PWD road on the edge of Kallettumkara over bridge in Potta- Moonupeedika road. The petitioner is allegedly conducting the fish stall on the road as mentioned above by encroaching the public road. The road where the petitioner is conducting the fish stall is not a market and it is causing lot of inconvenience and nuisance to the general public, besides being prone to accidents. It is further submitted that there is a foul smell and fish waste and water is accumulated there, and hence it is a host of mosquito and house flies. Since vehicles are parked over there, there exists a chance for accidents as well. This shed has been constructed without the permission from the PWD and therefore, same is to be demolished as per the impugned notice within a period of seven days. The petitioner had not replied to the said notice. 
WP(C) NO. 31525 OF 2024 2024:KER:69561 2. The petitioner has not produced any documents authorizing him to construct the shed to put up the stall for selling fish. 
The petitioner has encroached upon the public road and has unauthorizedly constructed the said fish stall. A violator of the law cannot come before this Court seeking the public law remedy to Stephan vs State Of Kerala on 11 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/71019136/
2 protect him from removal of encroachment of the public road. Therefore, I find no ground to interfere in the present writ petition. Thus, the present writ petition is hereby dismissed. 
Sd/-
